chunks: What al-Shaykh, may Allah support him, informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from his father, from Sahl ibn al-Yasaʿ, from his father, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a woman applying dye while she is menstruating. He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.تَخْتَضِبُ: applies dye, such as henna or similar coloring
key_terms.حَائِضٌ: a woman in the state of menstruation
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a menstruating woman to apply dye?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman applying dye. Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام states that there is no harm in it, indicating its permissibility during menstruation.
